records.source: Ah, the new farmer we've all been expecting... and whose arrival has sparked many a conversation!#$b#I'm Elliott... I live in the little cabin by the beach. It's a pleasure to meet you.
records.translation: Ah, ang bagong magsasakang hinihintay naming lahat... at ang pagdating mo ay naging paksa ng napakaraming usapan!#$b#Ako si Elliott... Nakatira ako sa munting Kubo sa tabi ng dalampasigan. Ikinagagalak kitang makilala.

records.source: I'm honored that you would remember my birthday! Thank you!$h
records.translation: Ikinararangal kong naalala mo ang kaarawan ko! Salamat!$h

records.source: Another year gone by, another gray hair... I suppose this gift can commemorate my decline.$s
records.translation: Lumipas na naman ang isang taon, nadagdagan na naman ang uban... Siguro ay maipangungunita ng regalong ito ang paghina ko.$s

records.source: Ah, what a gift! The aroma alone is inspiring...
records.translation: Ah, kaygandang regalo! Ang halimuyak pa lang ay nagbibigay na ng inspirasyon...

records.source: Of course... it would be an honor! I look forward to it.$h
records.translation: Siyempre... magiging isang karangalan iyon! Inaasam ko iyon.$h

records.source: Ah, you've been doing some beach combing... A fine hobby! Thank you.
records.translation: Ah, naghalughog ka sa dalampasigan... Isang mahusay na libangan! Salamat.

records.source: Ah, a book... Yes, perhaps the prose within these pages will offer a new insight. Thank you.
records.translation: Ah, isang aklat... Oo, marahil ay magbibigay ng bagong pananaw ang tuluyan sa mga pahinang ito. Salamat.

records.source: Ah, a bottle of fine ink. A writer can never have too much... and it's quite expensive! Thank you!$h
records.translation: Ah, isang bote ng de-kalidad na tinta. Hindi kailanman magkakaroon ng sobrang tinta ang isang manunulat... at napakamahal pa nito! Salamat!$h

records.source: This will make a beautiful quill! I feel inspired already...$h
records.translation: Maganda itong gawing panulat na balahibo! May inspirasyon na agad ako...$h

records.source: It's rare to see so many people at the beach. All for the love of squid!
records.translation: Bihirang makakita ng ganito karaming tao sa dalampasigan. Lahat dahil sa pagmamahal sa pusit!

records.source: Ah... please excuse the mess in my cabin. I wasn't expecting anyone to enter!
records.translation: Ah... pagpasensiyahan mo ang kalat sa Kubo ko. Wala akong inaasahang papasok!

records.source: Agh, it's still wriggling! Get that abomination away from me!$6 [154]
records.translation: Agh, gumagalaw-galaw pa ito! Ilayo mo sa akin ang kasuklam-suklam na bagay na iyan!$6 [154]

records.source: Agh, it's still wriggling! Get that abomination away from me!$6 [155]
records.translation: Agh, gumagalaw-galaw pa ito! Ilayo mo sa akin ang kasuklam-suklam na bagay na iyan!$6 [155]

records.source: I only wish I had given you a bouquet first!$l
records.translation: Sana ay ako muna ang nagbigay sa iyo ng pumpon ng bulaklak!$l

records.source: %Elliott whispers a sweet secret into your ear.
records.translation: %Ibinubulong ni Elliott sa tainga mo ang isang matamis na lihim.

records.source: You've plucked Pelican Town's finest flower... Now, you must care for it with all your heart.
records.translation: Pinitas mo ang pinakamagandang bulaklak sa Bayan ng Pelican... Ngayon, kailangan mo itong alagaan nang buong puso.

records.source: Well, if it isn't the town's number one ice fisher! That was truly an impressive performance.$h#$e#I never stand a chance, but I always participate just to be sporting.
records.translation: Aba, kung hindi ito ang pinakamahusay na mangingisda sa yelo ng bayan! Talagang kahanga-hanga ang ipinakita mo.$h#$e#Wala akong pagkakataong manalo, pero lagi akong sumasali para sa diwa ng palakasan.

records.source: Did you know? A duck's feather makes for an excellent quill.
records.translation: Alam mo ba? Mainam gawing panulat ang balahibo ng pato.

records.source: You've been very helpful... Now, I must think...
records.translation: Malaki ang naitulong mo... Ngayon, kailangan kong mag-isip...

records.source: I had a good time at the saloon the other day... Though my liver is not quite so enthusiastic...
records.translation: Nagsaya ako sa Stardrop Saloon noong isang araw... Bagaman hindi gaanong masaya ang atay ko...

records.source: That was quite the ride!
records.translation: Kaytindi ng biyaheng iyon!

records.source: I'll see you back in the valley.
records.translation: Magkita tayo pagbalik sa lambak.

records.source: Hopefully a crab hasn't snuck onto my clothes again.$s#$b#Imagine crawling out of a pocket and finding yourself on a beach hundreds of miles from home!$h#$e#Hmmm... Perhaps this could make for an interesting novel...
records.translation: Sana ay walang alimangong palihim na gumapang ulit sa damit ko.$s#$b#Isipin mong gumapang ka mula sa isang bulsa at biglang natagpuan ang sarili sa dalampasigang daan-daang milya mula sa tahanan!$h#$e#Hmmm... Marahil ay maaari itong maging isang kawili-wiling nobela...

records.source: I'm just taking a quick break to slather some coconut oil on my body.$h
records.translation: Saglit lang akong nagpapahinga para magpahid ng langis ng niyog sa katawan ko.$h

records.source: Gus, I'll order a round for everyone!#$b#*hic*... Oh... I don't have the G.$s#$b#Heh heh... Never mind!
records.translation: Gus, ako ang taya para sa lahat!#$b#*sinok*... Ah... Wala pala akong G.$s#$b#Heh heh... Huwag na lang!

records.source: I've heard rumors of pirates coming to shore near here at night. They say it can get pretty wild!
records.translation: May narinig akong mga sabi-sabing dumarating sa pampang malapit dito ang mga pirata pagsapit ng gabi. Sinasabing talagang nagiging magulo rito!

records.source: I must admit, this beach blows my own humble strand out of the water.
records.translation: Aaminin ko, di-hamak na mas maganda ang dalampasigang ito kaysa sa hamak kong munting baybayin.

records.source: Oh dear! Some seaweed has tangled itself in my hair.#$e#That's the trouble with relaxing on the beach.
records.translation: Naku po! May damong-dagat na napulupot sa buhok ko.#$e#Iyan ang problema sa pagpapahinga sa dalampasigan.

records.source: Yes... could I refuse that soft, kind face? The touch of spring-time's sweet embrace?
records.translation: Oo... paano ko tatanggihan ang banayad at mabait mong mukha? Ang matamis na haplos ng yakap ng tagsibol?

records.source: Excuse me... not today.$s
records.translation: Paumanhin... huwag ngayon.$s

records.source: ...$s#$e#Why do you torment me? Can't you see you've shattered all my hopes and dreams?$s
records.translation: ...$s#$e#Bakit mo ako pinahihirapan? Hindi mo ba nakikitang winasak mo ang lahat ng pag-asa at pangarap ko?$s

records.source: Go away. I can't bear to see you.$s
records.translation: Umalis ka. Hindi ko maatim na makita ka.$s

records.source: You've hurt me beyond measure... but I'm willing to leave the past behind us.$s
records.translation: Sinaktan mo ako nang labis-labis... pero handa akong iwan sa nakaraan ang nangyari.$s

records.source: Ah... the wilted bouquet. A sight I'd hoped to never see...$s#$b#I suppose there are other horizons to set my eyes upon...$s
records.translation: Ah... ang Nalantang Palumpon. Isang tanawing umasa akong hindi ko kailanman makikita...$s#$b#Siguro ay may iba pang abot-tanaw na maaari kong pagtuunan ng pansin...$s

records.source: I'm kind of new to this town myself, but I really feel at home.$h#$e#I moved here only a year before you.
records.translation: Medyo bago rin ako sa bayang ito, pero talagang parang tahanan ko ito.$h#$e#Isang taon lang akong naunang lumipat dito kaysa sa iyo.

records.source: I hope you've come to think of this place as 'home'.
records.translation: Sana ay itinuturing mo na ring “tahanan” ang lugar na ito.

records.source: A great idea can pass through your head when you least expect it... but if your mind is too busy you might miss it.#$e#Well, I really must get back to my work.
records.translation: Maaaring dumaan sa isip mo ang isang napakagandang ideya kapag hindi mo inaasahan... pero baka hindi mo ito mapansin kung napakaabala ng isip mo.#$e#Pero kailangan ko na talagang bumalik sa trabaho ko.

records.source: The sweet friction of pen and paper is the music of my soul.$u#$b#That's why I chose this beach as my home, so that I could have peace and quiet to do my work.
records.translation: Ang matamis na pagkiskis ng panulat sa papel ang musika ng kaluluwa ko.$u#$b#Kaya pinili ko ang dalampasigang ito bilang tahanan, upang payapa at tahimik akong makapagtrabaho.

records.source: The forest is a wonderful place. Have you been there?
records.translation: Kahanga-hangang lugar ang kagubatan. Nakapunta ka na ba roon?

records.source: Sorry, I'm feeling morose today.$s#$e#I wish there was more certainty about the future.$s#$e#I don't want to grow old as a lonely hermit on this beach...$s
records.translation: Pasensiya na, malungkot ang kalooban ko ngayon.$s#$e#Sana ay may higit na katiyakan tungkol sa hinaharap.$s#$e#Ayaw kong tumandang isang malungkot na ermitanyo sa dalampasigang ito...$s

records.source: I can't seem to find the inspiration to begin writing my novel...$s
records.translation: Hindi ko matagpuan ang inspirasyon upang simulan ang pagsusulat ng nobela ko...$s

records.source: I've been feeling hopeful lately. Perhaps the weather is changing.
records.translation: Umaasa ako nitong huli. Marahil ay nagbabago ang panahon.

records.source: Sometimes I wonder if I might just have an inflated self-image and no real skills...$s#$e#No, no... I'm not fishing for compliments. Though they are appreciated...
records.translation: Minsan ay iniisip ko kung napakataas lang ng tingin ko sa sarili at wala naman akong tunay na kakayahan...$s#$e#Hindi, hindi... Hindi ako nanghihingi ng papuri. Bagaman pinahahalagahan ko ang mga iyon...

records.source: #$1 elliottApol#It's a little lonely out here on the beach... so I apologize if I was ever a little too forward with you when we first met. I was just eager to have a friend.$k#$e#It feels good to have a close friend like you.
records.translation: #$1 elliottApol#Medyo malungkot dito sa dalampasigan... kaya humihingi ako ng paumanhin kung naging masyado akong mapangahas noong una tayong nagkita. Sabik lang akong magkaroon ng kaibigan.$k#$e#Masarap magkaroon ng matalik na kaibigang tulad mo.

records.source: Hello, @.#$e#Are you well?
records.translation: Kumusta, @.#$e#Ayos ka lang ba?

records.source: The fresh air of this valley is good for body and mind.#$e#A quick stroll outdoors always invigorates me.
records.translation: Mabuti sa katawan at isip ang sariwang hangin ng lambak na ito.#$e#Lagi akong pinasisigla ng maikling paglalakad sa labas.

records.source: Ah... do not get too close to my hair with a torch...$8
records.translation: Ah... huwag mong masyadong ilapit ang sulo sa buhok ko...$8

records.source: I'll admit... it takes me several hours each morning to make my hair look this good.
records.translation: Aaminin ko... ilang oras ang ginugugol ko tuwing umaga upang mapaganda nang ganito ang buhok ko.
